title: Two point contraction under an atom bound
statement: Let $q,\lambda,\gamma,u,v\in\bbr$ satisfy $q>2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $\lambda\le\gamma\le1-\lambda$. Set $p=q/(q-1)$ and $\rho=\rho(q,\lambda)$, the sharp discrete hypercontractive radius. Then $(\gamma u+(1-\gamma)v)^2+\rho^2\gamma(1-\gamma)(u-v)^2\le\big(\gamma|u|^p+(1-\gamma)|v|^p\big)^{2/p}$.
replaced: Let $q>2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, $\lambda\le\gamma\le1-\lambda$, and $u,v\in\bbr$. Put $p=q/(q-1)$ and $\rho=\rho_*(q,\lambda)$. Then $(\gamma u+(1-\gamma)v)^2+\rho^2\gamma(1-\gamma)(u-v)^2\le(\gamma|u|^p+(1-\gamma)|v|^p)^{2/p}$. Here $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(\ell/q)/\sinh(\ell/(q/(q-1)))}$ with $\ell=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
